Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas · School & learning

explain verb

also explanation

classical

Cic. Off. 1.16: potest et vidēre et explicāre ratiōnem
Traupman 26, 29

explicō, explicāre, explicāvī, explicātum

verb, first conjugation

explain, set out (literally, unfold)

With an object or an indirect question (Explicā, quaesō, quid in capite quārtō sit, Traupman 26); for “explained that …” use docēre or expōnere with an accusative and infinitive. Cicero’s perfect is explicāvī; explicuī comes in with Vergil and Livy (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • sī nēmō ex mē quaerat, sciō; sī quaerentī explicāre velim, nesciō

    if nobody asks me, I know; if I want to explain it to someone who asks, I don’tAug. Conf. 11.14.17

  • Inter edendum pater quid eō diē vīsūrī essent explicāvit

    Over breakfast Dad explained what they were going to see that dayLibellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

  • Tum pater docuit nōmen illud, ā rēge Francōrum antīquō ductum, 'pugnā clārum' significāre.

    Then Dad explained that the name, which comes from an old king of the Franks, means “famous in battle”.Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

Other words

  • expōnō, expōnere, exposuī, expositum — set out, explain (also with an accusative and infinitive)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Rep. 1.22: coepit ratiōnem hujus operis scientissimē Gallus expōnere (Lewis & Short)

  • doceō, docēre, docuī, doctum — explain that, show (with an accusative and infinitive)

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 16.8.1: docuī per litterās, id nec opus esse nec fierī posse

  • explānō, explānāre, explānāvī, explānātum — make plain, explain

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.94: facilius intellegī quam explānārī potest; Traupman 29

  • explānātiō, explānātiōnis f. — an explanation

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Div. 1.116 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 29

See also describe, lesson, know.

SourcesLewis & Short: explico · Lewis & Short: expono · Lewis & Short: doceo · Lewis & Short: explano · Lewis & Short: explanatio
